title: 三維渲染引擎
summary: 以幾何變換、光照與 GPU 管線同步串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect geometry transforms, lighting and gpu pipeline synchronization with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 座標與取樣
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「座標與取樣」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。

steps.title: 世界座標：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「世界座標」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Model, world, view and projection coordinates have separate transforms. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Transform a self-made point through translations and rotations. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
